appName.label: App name
appName.uniqueWarningDetail: on both App Store AND Google Play. Cannot use "free", "best", "#1", competitor names, or Apple/Google trademarks.

duns.label: DUNS number
duns.timelineNote: ~30 days to receive — or ~5 days with the expedited option (~€30)

appleOrgWarning.bannerBody: Apple Developer Program must be enrolled as an Organization account type. Individual accounts cannot be converted later and add 4 weeks + €99. If Apple creates an Individual account by mistake, we have an escalation process — but it adds ~4 weeks.
appleOrgWarning.reason1: Why: Individual accounts cannot publish under a business name or grant bsport admin access
appleOrgWarning.reason2: Apple creates Individual by mistake: sometimes Apple's system creates an Individual account instead of Organization — this is on Apple's side, not the client's
appleOrgWarning.reason3: Cannot be converted easily: if this happens, the client must request an account type migration, which takes ~4 additional weeks
appleOrgWarning.reason4: Manual selection: some clients accidentally select "Individual" during enrollment — the tutorial video specifically warns about this (watch 2:00–2:50)
appleOrgWarning.actionDetail: When you enroll in Apple Developer Program during the BACC call, double-check that you're selecting "Organization" and that the account confirmation email shows "Organization" type.

parallelNote: Runs in parallel with other tracks

p1_3.title: Request DUNS number
p1_3.note: ~30 days processing. Expedite option available (~€30 → ~5 days)
p1_3.video: How to request your DUNS number

p2_2.title: BACC intro call
p2_2.note: Scheduled immediately after the onboarding call. DUNS status determines the call agenda. Once DUNS is confirmed, GDA and ADP kick off in parallel with the Google and Apple setup steps below.

p2_3.title: Second BACC check-in
p2_3.note: Progress review while GDA/ADP steps are underway (not sequential)

p3_1.title: Google Developer Account (GDA) creation
p3_1.note: Create the client's GDA during the BACC call once DUNS is confirmed

p3_2.title: GDA verification
p3_2.note: If identity is already verified: same call. If not: verification call + up to 48h Google review

p3_3.title: Google Play Fastlane setup
p3_3.note: Service account for automatic Android updates. Can be done in the same call as verification

p4_1.title: Apple Developer Program enrollment
p4_1.note: MUST be Organization type (not Individual). If Apple creates an Individual account by mistake, the escalation process adds ~4 weeks. Watch the enrollment tutorial (2:00–2:50 covers this).
p4_1.video: Apple Developer Program enrollment (watch 2:00–2:50 for the account type warning)

p4_2.title: Verify account type
p4_2.note: Check the confirmation email: it must say "Organization". If it says Individual, contact bsport immediately for escalation

p4_3.title: Add bsport as admin
p4_3.note: Grant bsport admin access to your Apple Developer Program account
p4_3.video: Adding bsport as admin on Apple Developer

p4_4.title: Setup API credentials & DSA agreement
p4_4.note: API keys and Developer Sales Agreement. Done once bsport has admin access

p5_2.title: App submitted to App Store
p5_2.note: Typically reviewed in 1-2 days (sometimes longer for first-time submissions)

p5_3.title: Apps go live
p5_3.note: Both stores approve → apps published. Download links shared with you

p6_2.title: Updates & support
p6_2.note: We handle updates to keep your app running smoothly
